title: Build a plain-text greeting formatter
body:
## What to build

Accept a name and return a plain-text greeting consisting of Hello followed by a space and that name. The formatter input/output is the test seam. No UI or storage is in scope.

**Model tier:** regular

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given the name Ada, the formatter returns exactly Hello Ada.
- [ ] The returned greeting uses the supplied name.
- [ ] Automated tests verify the behavior through formatter input/output.
- [ ] The formatter requires no UI or storage.
